query: Never Stop The fisherman's rule for the wind is "never stop". You take the long way round the lake on your free afternoon to practise it, and the wind gets behind you as soon as you're off the jetty. Never stop You go round the lake three times without stopping, faster each lap, until your hands are numb on the handle. The fisherman waves every lap now. Land and talk to him You land by his boat and tell him about the storm run. He listens, nods, and says, "Never stop," again, and hands you a fish to take home.
